claim: Weingut Van Volxem in Wiltingen offers vinothek tastings Wednesday-Sunday 11:00-17:00 with commentated counter tastings without reservation, plus bookable cellar and vineyard tours.
quote: The wine shop is open from Wednesday to Sunday from 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM... commentated wine tasting available without reservation at the counter during opening hours, with the last opportunity 1 hour before closing.

claim: Van Volxem's 2019 visitor centre features an eight-metre panoramic glass vinothek overlooking the Scharzhofberg.
quote: On the ground floor of the wine experience tower, a vinothek invites visitors to enjoy the views and taste the cellar's treasures, with panoramic glass panels spanning over eight metres offering views of the Scharzhofberg.

claim: Van Volxem hosts its 2026 vintage presentation with grand tasting, star-cuisine bites and live music on 5-6 September 2026.
quote: A vintage presentation event featuring a grand wine tasting of the new collection in the cellars, exclusive rare samples, exquisite dishes from star cuisine and relaxed live music on the summer terrace is scheduled for September 5-6, 2026.

claim: Weingut Egon Müller-Scharzhof in Wiltingen is by-appointment only and does not sell directly to private customers.
quote: It is impossible to visit the Scharzhof without an appointment... Unusually for Germany, the estate does not sell directly to private customers.

claim: Weingut Peter Lauer in Ayl is a VDP estate run by Florian Lauer working 12 hectares of slate-rich Saar vineyards including the Ayler Kupp.
quote: Florian Lauer, who, alongside his father Peter, meticulously oversees 12 hectares of steep, slate-rich vineyards, including iconic sites like the Ayler Kupp, Schonfels, and the reclaimed Lambertskirch.

claim: Peter Lauer offers year-round VDP six-wine vinothek tastings Monday-Friday at 11:00 and 14:00 for €20/person, bookable through Saar-Obermosel Tourism.
quote: The VDP wine tasting with 6 wines in the Vinothek of the Peter Lauer winery in Ayl takes place year-round from Monday to Friday at 11:00 and 14:00 PM and lasts about 1 hour. Tickets are available for €20.00/person.

claim: Weingut Forstmeister Geltz-Zilliken in Saarburg, an 11th-generation VDP estate led by Dorothee Zilliken, offers 8-wine tastings by appointment for €25/person, redeemable on purchase.
quote: The tasting includes 8 wines and will cost 25 € per person. This amount can be offset when ordering after the tasting.

claim: SaarRieslingSommer 2026 takes place 29-30 August with 10 wineries from Serrig to Konz-Filzen opening their cellars 12:00-18:00, linked by a shuttle.
quote: The festival takes place on August 29th and 30th, 2026 between 12:00 - 18:00 hours, with 10 stations along the Saar opening their doors and cellars... a shuttle service operates between the wineries.

claim: The Saarweinfest in Saarburg runs 5-7 September 2026, turning the old town into a wine street with the Saar-Obermosel wine queen coronation, fireworks and a Sunday parade.
quote: The festival transforms Saarburg's old town into a convivial wine street for three days. The Saarweinfest presents wine, live music, the coronation of the Saar-Obermosel wine queens, musical fireworks over the Saar, and the traditional parade on Sunday.

claim: Weingut Ökonomierat Petgen-Dahm in Perl-Sehndorf farms 17 ha across Mosel and the Saar's Ayler Kupp, specialising in white and red Burgundy plus Riesling, with eight Saarland Grand State Honour Awards.
quote: The estate belongs to the most renowned wineries in the Moselle-Saar-Ruwer region and is among the very few in this area to have specialized in the cultivation of white and red Burgundy vines... eight Saarland Grand State Honour Awards.

claim: Perl wineries rotate weekend cellar openings April-October, and the village hosts Saarland's only commercial viticulture, including Bioweingut Ollinger-Gelz and Petgen-Dahm.
quote: At weekends from April until October, the wineries in Perl open their wine cellars on a rotating basis and invite visitors to enjoy their still and sparkling wines in a cosy atmosphere.

claim: Stage 1 of the Moselsteig long-distance trail starts in Perl and passes Nennig with its Roman mosaic, offering three-country views of Germany, Luxembourg and France.
quote: The first stage of the Moselsteig Trail cannot fail to inspire visitors with its proximity to nature, open countryside and its unique views over three countries: Germany, Luxembourg and France. The path passes the access routes to Sinz and to Nennig with its unique Roman mosaic.

claim: Across the river in Luxembourg, Domaines Vinsmoselle, the country's largest crémant producer, runs cellar visits at Remerschen (Caves du Sud), Wellenstein, Wormeldange and Grevenmacher, all reachable from Perl via Schengen.
quote: Domaines Vinsmoselle has four sites along the Moselle, in Remerschen, Wellenstein, Wormeldange and Grevenmacher, where staff take great pleasure in presenting the best vintages to visitors.
